module.name: LACTOS
module.purpose: Defines the Localized Anisotropic Collision and Triadic Ontology System — collision regime taxonomy (P/Q/N classes), cross-ontology mapping (SO/ISO), event pipeline, triadic alignment wheel, and VCG integration for structured collision-to-computation translation.

files.purpose: Navigation index for the LACTOS subsystem — introduces the collision-aware backbone, describes all five core artifacts, and maps LACTOS into the broader canon architecture.
Canonical signature defining the P/Q/N collision regime structure — stability classes, anisotropic signatures (A-Type/L-Type/S-Type), and entropy-based stability indicators.
Engine mapping LACTOS collision regimes into Star Ontology (SO) and Inverted Star Ontology (ISO) interpretations — enabling tri-ontology coherence across translation surfaces.
Operator-facing engine defining the end-to-end collision event pipeline — raw event ingestion, regime classification, ontology translation, VCG handoff, and downstream analysis.
Structural map and visual alignment wheel showing how LACTOS, SO, and ISO interlock through rotational symmetry and triadic coherence.
Operator-facing engine describing how LACTOS outputs feed into the Virtual Compute Gateway for compute-safe translation and downstream ingestion.
